templates.name: First time in a gym
templates.blurb: One full-body session you repeat three times a week, all on machines. Machines hold the movement for you, so there is much less to get wrong while you learn.
templates.who: You have never lifted, or it has been long enough that it feels that way.
templates.source: Built on the ACSM guidance of 8–10 full-body exercises for new lifters, in the shape gyms like Gold's teach it.
templates.notes: Leave a day between sessions. Add weight only when the last set feels easy.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower until your knees are near 90 degrees. Never lock your knees hard at the top.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.cue: Set the seat so the handles sit at chest height. Press out smoothly, don't lock the elbows.

exercises.name: Seated Row Machine
exercises.cue: Chest against the pad, pull the handles to your ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.cue: Thighs under the pad. Pull the bar to your collarbone leading with the elbows. No swinging.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.cue: Seat height so the handles start at shoulder level. Press up without shrugging.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Pad just above your heels. Curl towards your backside, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Straight line head to heels. Squeeze your glutes so your hips don't sag.

templates.name: r/Fitness Basic Beginner Routine
templates.blurb: Two alternating barbell sessions, three days a week: A, B, A one week and B, A, B the next. Five movements total, so you can learn them properly.
templates.who: New to barbells and happy to use a squat rack.
templates.source: The r/Fitness wiki's primary recommended beginner routine.
templates.notes: Run this for three months at most, then move up to something with more volume. Add 1.25 kg to upper-body lifts and 2.5 kg to lower-body lifts each time you do them; over ten reps on the last set, double it. If you cannot get fifteen reps across the three sets, drop the weight 10 percent next time.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinched back, feet flat. Bar to mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. Use the rack safeties or ask for a spot.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.cue: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width. Sit down between your hips, knees over your toes. Go as deep as you can keep a flat back.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.cue: Palms facing you, hang with straight arms, pull until your chin clears the bar. Use the assisted machine or a band if you need to.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Bar at collarbone height, stomach tight. Press up and slightly back so it finishes over your ears.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar over mid-foot, shins close, flat back, chest up. Push the floor away instead of yanking. Stop the set the moment your back rounds.

templates.name: Gym Phase 1
templates.blurb: Two main lifting days plus two light days for grip, core and arms, with cardio built in. More work than a bare beginner routine without being overwhelming.
templates.who: You have a few weeks behind you and want more than three sessions.
templates.notes: Main lifts alternate A, B, A. Light day X always follows A and Y always follows B.

exercises.name: Seated Rows
exercises.cue: Chest tall, pull the handle to your belly button, squeeze your shoulder blades together, control it back out.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinched back, feet flat. Bar to mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. Use the rack safeties or ask for a spot.

exercises.name: Squats

exercises.name: Deadlift

exercises.name: Face pulls
exercises.cue: Rope at eye height. Pull towards your forehead, elbows high and wide. Light weight, slow.

exercises.name: Supermans
exercises.cue: Face down, lift your chest and thighs off the floor and hold.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.cue: A heavy dumbbell in each hand. Stand tall, walk steady, don't lean.

exercises.name: Plate pinches
exercises.cue: Pinch two plates smooth-side-out between thumb and fingers. Hold.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.cue: Hang from the bar, arms straight, shoulders pulled slightly down.

exercises.name: Curls
exercises.cue: Elbows still, no swinging. Lower slower than you lift.

exercises.name: Calf raises
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top of every rep.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Straight line head to heels. Squeeze your glutes so your hips don't sag.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raises
exercises.cue: Hang still, lift your legs without swinging. Bend the knees if it's too hard.

exercises.name: Weighted crunches
exercises.cue: Weight on your chest, curl your ribs towards your hips. Don't pull on your neck.

templates.name: GZCLP
templates.blurb: Four rotating sessions, three a week. Each one has a heavy lift, a lighter version of another lift, and an accessory — so you get far more volume than a plain beginner routine.
templates.who: You have finished a beginner routine and want the next step up.
templates.source: Cody Lefever's GZCLP, the routine the r/Fitness wiki names as the usual step after the beginner program.
templates.notes: Heavy lift: five sets of three, last set as many as you can. Middle lift: three sets of ten. Accessory: three sets of fifteen, last set as many as you can — add weight there once you pass twenty-five.

templates.name: Dumbbells only
templates.blurb: A full-body session with nothing but a pair of dumbbells and a bench. Works at home or in a busy gym where the racks are always taken.
templates.who: No barbell, or you would rather not use one yet.
templates.source: A standard full-body dumbbell template, same movement patterns as the barbell routines.
templates.notes: Repeat the same session two or three times a week with a rest day between.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Hold one dumbbell at your chest. Sit down between your hips, elbows inside your knees.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at chest height, press up until they nearly touch. Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: One knee and hand on a bench, flat back, pull the dumbbell to your hip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, dumbbells sliding down your thighs, flat back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at shoulder height, press overhead without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Straight line head to heels. Squeeze your glutes so your hips don't sag.

templates.name: Upper and lower, four days
templates.blurb: Two upper-body days and two lower-body days a week. More exercises per session and more room for the bits you want to bring up.
templates.who: You have trained consistently for a while and want four sessions.
templates.source: The standard four-day upper/lower split recommended for intermediates.
templates.notes: Upper, lower, rest, upper, lower, rest, rest works well.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift

library.name: Back Squat
library.cue: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width. Sit down between your hips, knees tracking over your toes. Go as deep as you can keep a flat back.

library.name: Goblet Squat
library.cue: Hold one dumbbell at your chest. Sit down between your hips, elbows inside your knees, chest tall.

library.name: Leg Press
library.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the platform. Lower until your knees are near 90 degrees. Never slam your knees straight at the top.

library.name: Hack Squat Machine
library.cue: Shoulders under the pads, feet mid-platform. Lower slowly, push through the whole foot.

library.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
library.cue: Back foot on a bench, drop straight down, front knee tracking over the foot. Hold the rail if you wobble.

library.name: Walking Lunge
library.cue: Long step forward, back knee towards the floor, stand up through the front heel.

library.name: Deadlift
library.cue: Bar over mid-foot, shins close, flat back, chest up. Push the floor away instead of yanking. Stop the set the moment your back rounds.

library.name: Romanian Deadlift
library.cue: Soft knees, push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs. Stop when you feel the stretch behind your knees.

library.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
library.cue: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, dumbbells sliding down your thighs, back flat throughout.

library.name: Hip Thrust
library.cue: Shoulders on a bench, bar padded across the hips. Drive through your heels, squeeze at the top, keep your ribs down.

library.name: Hip Thrust Machine
library.cue: Back against the pad, belt or bar across your hips. Drive through your heels, squeeze at the top, ribs down.

library.name: Single-leg Romanian Deadlift
library.cue: Stand on one leg, hinge forward reaching the dumbbell towards the floor, back flat. Hold something for balance.

library.name: Glute Bridge
library.cue: On your back, feet flat and close to your backside. Drive the hips up, squeeze, lower slowly.

library.name: Back Extension
library.cue: Pads at your hips, fold forward with a flat back, squeeze your glutes to come up. No swinging.

library.name: Leg Curl
library.cue: Pad just above your heels. Curl towards your backside, lower slowly.

library.name: Glute Machine
library.cue: Feet flat, drive the hips up, pause at the top, lower under control.

library.name: Bench Press
library.cue: Shoulder blades pinched back, feet flat. Bar to mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. Use the rack safeties or ask for a spot.

library.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
library.cue: Dumbbells at chest height, press up until they nearly touch. Keep your wrists straight over your elbows.

library.name: Chest Press Machine
library.cue: Set the seat so the handles sit at chest height. Press out smoothly, don't snap your elbows straight.

library.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
library.cue: Bench at about 30 degrees. Press up and slightly together, control the way down.

library.name: Dumbbell Fly
library.cue: Lie back, soft elbows, open your arms wide then bring them together above your chest.

library.name: Push-ups
library.cue: Hands under your shoulders, body in a straight line. Hands on a bench makes it easier.

library.name: Cable Fly
library.cue: Soft elbows, bring the handles together in front of your chest like you're hugging someone.

library.name: Overhead Press
library.cue: Bar at collarbone height, stomach tight. Press up and slightly back so it finishes over your ears.

library.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
library.cue: Dumbbells at shoulder height, press overhead without arching your lower back.

library.name: Shoulder Press Machine
library.cue: Seat height so the handles start at shoulder level. Press up without shrugging.

library.name: Lateral Raise
library.cue: Light dumbbells, lift out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows.

library.name: Barbell Row
library.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.

library.name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
library.cue: One knee and hand on a bench, flat back, pull the dumbbell to your hip.

library.name: Seated Row Machine
library.cue: Chest against the pad, pull the handles to your ribs, squeeze your shoulder blades together.

library.name: Cable Row
library.cue: Sit tall, pull to your belly button, shoulders back, control the return.

library.name: Face Pull
library.cue: Rope at eye height. Pull towards your forehead with elbows high and wide. Light weight, slow.

library.name: Rear Delt Fly
library.cue: Hinge forward, light dumbbells, open your arms out to the sides like wings.

library.name: Shrug
library.cue: Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears, pause, lower slowly. No rolling.

library.name: Lat Pulldown
library.cue: Thighs under the pad. Pull the bar to your collarbone leading with the elbows. No swinging.

library.name: Chin-ups
library.cue: Palms facing you, hang with straight arms, pull until your chin clears the bar. The assisted machine or a band is fine.

library.name: Straight-arm Pulldown
library.cue: Arms nearly straight, sweep the bar down to your thighs using your back, not your arms.

library.name: Dumbbell Curl
library.cue: Elbows still at your sides, no swinging. Lower slower than you lift.

library.name: Hammer Curl
library.cue: Palms facing each other the whole way. Elbows pinned to your sides.

library.name: Tricep Pushdown
library.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides. Straighten the arms fully, control the way back.

library.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
library.cue: One dumbbell behind your head, elbows pointing up, straighten the arms.

library.name: Calf Raise
library.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause for a second at the top of every rep.

library.name: Standing Calf Raise
library.cue: Balls of your feet on a step, heels down for a stretch, up onto your toes and hold.

library.name: Leg Extension
library.cue: Pad above your ankles. Straighten the legs, pause a beat, lower under control.

library.name: Plank
library.cue: Straight line from head to heels. Squeeze your glutes so your hips don't sag.

library.name: Hanging Leg Raise
library.cue: Hang still, then lift your legs without swinging. Bend the knees if straight legs are too hard.

library.name: Cable Crunch
library.cue: Kneel facing the machine, rope by your head, curl your ribs down towards your hips.

library.name: Dead Bug
library.cue: On your back, lower opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping your lower back flat on the floor.

library.name: Pallof Press
library.cue: Stand side-on to the cable, press the handle straight out and resist the twist.

library.name: Ab Machine
library.cue: Set the seat, curl your ribs down towards your hips, control the return.

library.name: Farmer's Carry
library.cue: A heavy dumbbell in each hand. Stand tall, shoulders down, walk steady without leaning.

library.name: Front Squat
library.cue: Bar across the front of your shoulders, elbows high. Sit straight down, chest up.

library.name: Box Squat
library.cue: Sit back onto a box at about parallel, pause, then drive up. Good for learning depth.

library.name: Step-up
library.cue: Whole foot on the bench, drive through that heel, control the way down.

library.name: Sissy Squat
library.cue: Hold a rail, lean back and bend the knees forward. Slow, small range at first.

library.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
library.cue: Stand inside the frame, handles at your sides. Easier on the lower back than a straight bar.

library.name: Sumo Deadlift
library.cue: Wide stance, hands inside your knees. Push the floor apart as you stand.

library.name: Good Morning
library.cue: Light bar on your back, hinge forward with soft knees and a flat back. Start very light.

library.name: Kettlebell Swing
library.cue: Hinge, not squat. Snap the hips through and let the bell float — arms stay relaxed.

library.name: Incline Bench Press
library.cue: Bench at about 30 degrees. Bar to the top of your chest, elbows tucked slightly.

library.name: Close-grip Bench Press
library.cue: Hands about shoulder width. Elbows close to your sides the whole way.

library.name: Dips
library.cue: Lean forward slightly for chest, upright for triceps. Use the assisted machine if you need to.

library.name: Pec Deck
library.cue: Elbows at chest height on the pads. Squeeze the handles together, control the way back.

library.name: Arnold Press
library.cue: Start with palms facing you, rotate outwards as you press overhead.

library.name: Push Press
library.cue: A small dip of the knees, then drive the bar overhead. Lets you handle more than a strict press.

library.name: Cable Lateral Raise
library.cue: Cable at the bottom, lift out to the side to shoulder height, slow on the way down.

library.name: Chest-supported Row
library.cue: Chest on the pad so you cannot cheat with your lower back. Pull to your ribs.

library.name: T-bar Row
library.cue: Hinge over the bar, flat back, pull the handles to your stomach.

library.name: Inverted Row
library.cue: Bar at hip height, body straight, pull your chest to the bar. Bend your knees to make it easier.

library.name: Neutral-grip Pulldown
library.cue: Palms facing each other. Easier on the shoulders than a wide grip.

library.name: Pull-ups
library.cue: Palms facing away, hang with straight arms, pull until your chin clears the bar.

library.name: Preacher Curl
library.cue: Arms flat on the pad. No swinging is even possible, which is the point.

library.name: Cable Curl
library.cue: Constant tension the whole way. Elbows stay at your sides.

library.name: Skullcrusher
library.cue: Lying down, lower the bar to your forehead by bending only at the elbow.

library.name: Tricep Dip Machine
library.cue: Seat set so the handles are at chest height. Press down, elbows close.

library.name: Seated Calf Raise
library.cue: Knees bent under the pad. Full stretch down, pause at the top.

library.name: Ab Wheel
library.cue: From your knees, roll out only as far as you can keep your back flat. Very short range at first.

library.name: Side Plank
library.cue: On one forearm, hips stacked and lifted. Hold, then swap sides.

library.name: Russian Twist
library.cue: Sit leaning back, feet up if you can, rotate the weight side to side under control.

library.name: Hip Abduction Machine
library.cue: Sit tall, push your knees apart against the pads, pause, return slowly.

library.name: Glute Kickback
library.cue: Hips square, drive one leg back and up, squeeze at the top. No arching your lower back.

library.name: Kettlebell Swing
library.cue: Hinge at the hips, snap them forward. The arms just hold on — it is not a lift with the shoulders.

library.name: Lateral Raise Machine
library.cue: Pads on the outside of your arms, lift out to shoulder height, lower slowly.

library.name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
library.cue: Kneel on the pad, hang with straight arms, pull until your chin clears the bar. More assistance is a lighter pull.

library.name: Reverse Crunch
library.cue: On your back, knees bent, curl your hips off the floor towards your chest. Slow, not swung.

library.name: Suitcase Carry
library.cue: One heavy dumbbell in one hand. Walk tall without leaning away from it.
